name: AISDR
summary: Deploy an autonomous AI Sales Development Rep. It qualifies leads, books meetings, and handles initial outreach conversations 24/7.
best_for: sales teams with a clear ICP and offer that want autonomous AI to qualify leads, personalize outreach and book meetings around the clock
skip_if: you haven't nailed your targeting and messaging yet (automation will scale the wrong thing), or your volume can't justify a ~$900/mo quarterly commitment
honest_knock: It's priced like an SDR salary because it's meant to replace part of that function — so judge it on cost-per-meeting, not the sticker, and expect a quarterly commitment rather than a flip-the-switch monthly. Autonomous AI outreach is only as good as your targeting, list quality and messaging guardrails; point it at a bad list and you'll automate bad outreach (and risk your sending reputation). For teams with a solid ICP and offer, it can book meetings at a real cost-per-meeting; for those still figuring out messaging, it's premature. Checked again on 9 September 2026, after AiSDR shipped Ami, the GTM agent it now puts in front of every plan: you hand it your website, it comes back with a target list and a live campaign, and it keeps adjusting the ones that stall. The genuinely new part is memory - your ICP, your exclusions and what a past campaign taught it carry over instead of resetting with each new campaign - and Ami sits inside Solo at $250/mo with no sales call, so the cheapest way in no longer runs through a demo. The scale numbers on the launch page (17,150 campaigns learned from, 19,501 meetings behind them, a rolling 30-day pipeline counter) are AiSDR's own and unaudited, so read them as marketing rather than evidence. And Ami changes none of the deliverability arithmetic: AiSDR's own pricing page still says it takes 30+ days to get multiple inboxes safely warmed, so a first campaign in 20 minutes is the launch, not the result.

pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-09-09 on AiSDR's own pricing page) There are three published plans. Solo is $250/mo or $2,400/yr for a sales team of one: 200 AI-researched contacts a month, 1 user, 1 domain, 3 mailboxes, month-to-month. Explore is $900/mo or $8,640/yr (800 contacts a month, unlimited users, 2 domains, 6 mailboxes), and Scale $2,500/mo or $24,000/yr. Annual billing takes 20% off. Explore and Scale carry a quarterly commitment; Solo runs month to month. Managed service is extra: +$149 per campaign, or fully managed from +$2,500/mo. Enterprise is custom. Priced by contact volume rather than by seat above Solo.
